Title: Meeting on App Launch, Bugs, and Release Plan
## Summary
The team discussed the mobile app launch date of March 15th to ensure the login fix lands by Friday, while also reviewing open bugs and updating design icons.
## Key points
- The Android build is stable regarding the crash on the settings screen.
- Battery usage will be down by 20%.
- The design team will provide updated icons by Thursday.
- The launch plans are decided by agreeing with Daniel on the login fix.
## Decisions
- "None recorded."
## Action items
- [ ] Owner: Task assigned to the group regarding the release notes and screen shots.
- [ ] Owner: Task assigned to Daniel regarding the login fix.
- [ ] Owner: Task assigned to Karen regarding the updated icons and release notes.
- [ ] Owner: Task assigned to the group regarding the March 15th launch plan.
## Open questions
- "None recorded."
